mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the FEDFUNDS rate increased by more than 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points within three months signals an improving labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.3 percentage points within three months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate sales (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals a strong demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the periods following a sustained increase in HOUST over three months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% within a month signals an increase in supply-side capacity, which can lead to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4.5% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals a tight labor market with strong job growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4.5% and PAYEMS increases > 200k in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE was below 4.5% and PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% within a month signals a weakening consumer demand, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where RSAFS decreased by more than 1% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals inflationary pressure in a high-interest-rate environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where FEDFUNDS was above 4% and CPIAUCSL increased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a strong economic growth, which is a leading indicator of corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the periods following a sustained increase in GDPC1 over two consecutive quarters.
